messages:
prashant: Quick flag 01 last night 23:12-23:28 we saw a p99 tail spike on /generate in US: ~480ms -> ~1.3s, p95 also rose but throughput steady. Linked traces show KV cache misses spiking.

maria: Thanks. Can someone confirm if any config changes went out before the window?

prashant: Yep  small canary that set KV TTL=0 for a subset of requests pushed late afternoon. Looks like it rolled to 10% canary traffic.

maria: Okay. Proposed immediate follow-ups:
- revert canary TTL override to previous value for canary traffic (owner: prashant, target: tonight deploy window)
- add KV hit/miss ratio panel to SLO dashboard + p99 by endpoint (owner: alex, target: 48h)
- temporary SLO tweak: relax p99 to 900ms and pause non-critical rollout triggers for 7d (owner: tara, target: 2024-05-08)
- add an automated detector: if p99 > 2x baseline for 15m, create high-priority alert (owner: maria, target: 2024-05-06)

alex: PromQL to expose miss ratio if helpful: ```sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_inference_kv_request_total[5m]))``` will give a 5m miss ratio across instances. I can add 1m/5m variants.

tara: For the temporary SLO change I suggest exact wording: "Service p99 for /generate permitted to exceed baseline up to 900ms for 7 days while we validate KV fix. If error-budget burn >20% within that window, pause public feature rollouts." I'll draft in governance doc.

prashant: Plan for revert: open revert PR to revert TTL flag in the canary config, deploy to canary, observe 6h, then consider promoting. I'll also instrument canary to tag requests with TTL variant so we can correlate. Owner: prashant.

maria: Dashboard runbook (brief) to add to the ticket: 1) check KV miss ratio by prefix, 2) check p99 /generate by region, 3) check GPU queue length and runqueue. If p99 falls below 700ms after revert in 6h, unpause error-budget.

alex: I'll add the panels and a tiny runbook note in the dashboard. Also adding a request-size distribution panel to correlate long prompts with increased miss ratio.

sre-bot: Incident 2024-04-30-2312: state updated to "followup-in-progress". Owners: prashant, alex, tara.

maria: Ticket checklist I'll create: revert PR, canary tag instrumentation, dashboard panels (miss ratio + req size + p99), temp SLO doc, synth monitors per region, 6-24h observation window.

tara: I'll prepare the governance PR and include rollback criteria: if p99 > 850ms for any 30m sliding window after revert, escalate back to postmortem.

prashant: Revert PR targeted for tonight. I'll post status in #oncall when done.

alex: ack, will finish panels in next 24h and ping here.

maria: Great. We'll reconvene at tomorrow's handoff and in SLO sync next week. Thanks everyone.

sre-bot: Reminder: SLO governance sync scheduled 2024-05-07 16:00 UTC.
